name: Porlex Tall
details: Tall hand grinder with ceramic conical burrs; clicks counted from zero.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 1, espresso 2–3, moka pot 4–5, AeroPress 3–8, V60 4–6, filter coffee machine 3–7, French press 6–11, cold brew 7–12. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
